aiVerification.summary: Draft misidentifies the changed factor and omits key report outcomes, so it is not safe as final evidence.
issues: Changed factor is wrong: SM VISION is a test type, not the changed condition.
Correct comparison appears to be Ruijin clean Primer vs Normal clean alcohol.
Only vision outcome is modeled; glue, drop, and tension decisions are omitted.
Subgroup key is used as the changed condition evidence instead of the comparison condition.
Evidence rows include generic headers but miss cited outcome support for the full report.
correctionPlan: Set baselineCondition to Normal clean alcohol.
Set changedCondition to Ruijin clean Primer or Ruijin clean with Primer.
Keep SM VISION as the vision test context, not the changed factor.
Add outcomes for separate glue, drop test, and tension under the same changed factor.
Cite rows supporting each outcome and final decision rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are misassigned and incomplete for final evidence.
